name: @foreverworks/mcp-anaf-spv
description: MCP server for ANAF's Spațiul Privat Virtual (pfinternet.anaf.ro): download what ANAF posts to a taxpayer, request new documents, validate declarations and file a D212; it signs in by itself

mcp.title: ANAF SPV
mcp.tagline: Download what ANAF posts to your SPV inbox, request documents, and validate or file declarations.

ANAF_SPV_USERNAME.title: SPV user name
ANAF_SPV_USERNAME.description: Your SPV user name, when the password comes from a file.

ANAF_SPV_PASSWORD_FILE.title: SPV password file
ANAF_SPV_PASSWORD_FILE.description: Path of a file holding your SPV password. The README also shows how to read it from a vault MCP server instead.

ANAF_SPV_MAIL_MCP_URL.title: Mail MCP server URL
ANAF_SPV_MAIL_MCP_URL.description: A mail MCP server over Streamable HTTP that reads the mailbox SPV sends its codes to, so a sign-in reads the code by itself. Without one (or a command below), every sign-in asks you for the code.

ANAF_SPV_MAIL_MCP_TOKEN_FILE.title: Mail MCP token file
ANAF_SPV_MAIL_MCP_TOKEN_FILE.description: Path of a file holding that mail server's bearer token, if it wants one.

ANAF_SPV_MAIL_MCP_COMMAND.title: Mail MCP command
ANAF_SPV_MAIL_MCP_COMMAND.description: Instead of a URL: a mail MCP server to start over stdio, as a JSON array such as ["npx","-y","some-mail-mcp"].

author: Forever Works
